domestic.entry_zh: 个人身份证即可开店，支付宝实名认证，1000元消费者保障保证金（部分类目可交30元保险代替）
domestic.entry_en: Individual ID card required, Alipay real-name verification, 1000 RMB deposit (or 30 RMB insurance for some categories)
domestic.commission: 无佣金，仅收取软件服务费（按类目0.6%-5%）
domestic.commission_en: No commission, software service fee 0.6%-5% by category
domestic.settlement: 确认收货后实时到账支付宝
domestic.traffic: 搜索流量为主，需配合直通车/万相台推广
domestic.pros_zh: 开店门槛最低，适合个人新手起步
domestic.pros_en: Lowest barrier to entry, ideal for beginners
domestic.cons_zh: 竞争激烈，新店流量获取难，价格战严重
domestic.cons_en: High competition, difficult for new stores to get traffic

domestic.entry_zh: 需企业营业执照+商标注册证（R标）或TM受理通知书，保证金5-15万，年费3-6万
domestic.entry_en: Business license + trademark required, deposit 50k-150k RMB, annual fee 30k-60k RMB
domestic.traffic: 品牌信任度高，搜索权重优于淘宝
domestic.pros_zh: 品牌背书强，用户信任度高，流量倾斜
domestic.pros_en: Strong brand credibility, preferred traffic allocation
domestic.cons_zh: 入驻门槛高，资金要求大，运营成本高
domestic.cons_en: High entry barrier, significant capital requirements

domestic.entry_zh: 企业营业执照，保证金1-10万，平台使用费1000元/月，京东物流可选
domestic.entry_en: Business license, deposit 10k-100k RMB, 1000 RMB/month platform fee
domestic.traffic: 自营+第三方模式，物流体验好
domestic.pros_zh: 物流体验极佳，用户消费力强，3C家电优势明显
domestic.pros_en: Excellent logistics, high-spending users, strong in electronics
domestic.cons_zh: 扣点高，入仓要求严格，运营成本不低

domestic.entry_zh: 个人身份证或企业执照均可，保证金1000元起（企业店1000-10000元）
domestic.entry_en: Individual or business license, deposit from 1000 RMB
domestic.traffic: 社交裂变+百亿补贴，低价策略驱动
domestic.pros_zh: 起量快，门槛低，下沉市场大
domestic.pros_en: Fast scaling, low barrier, large lower-tier market
domestic.cons_zh: 价格战极端，利润薄，售后压力大
domestic.cons_en: Extreme price competition, thin margins, heavy after-sales

domestic.entry_zh: 个人身份证可开橱窗（1000粉丝+发布10条视频+实名认证），企业店需营业执照
domestic.entry_en: 1000 followers + 10 videos + real-name verification for showcase; business license for stores
domestic.traffic: 兴趣电商，短视频+直播带货，算法推荐
domestic.pros_zh: 流量巨大，爆发力强，内容驱动转化
domestic.pros_en: Massive traffic, explosive growth, content-driven conversion
domestic.cons_zh: 需内容创作能力，退货率较高，流量不稳定
domestic.cons_en: Requires content creation skills, high return rates, unstable traffic

domestic.entry_zh: 个人身份证实名认证，快手小店保证金500元起
domestic.traffic: 老铁经济，私域粘性强，直播带货为主
domestic.pros_zh: 私域复购率高，下沉市场用户忠诚度高
domestic.pros_en: Strong private domain repurchase, loyal lower-tier users
domestic.cons_zh: 公域流量较小，品牌溢价能力弱
domestic.cons_en: Limited public traffic, weak brand premium

domestic.entry_zh: 个人身份证实名认证，1000粉丝可开通店铺，保证金1000元起
domestic.entry_en: Real-name verification, 1000 followers for store opening, deposit from 1000 RMB
domestic.traffic: 种草社区，女性用户为主，消费力强
domestic.pros_zh: 用户消费力强，种草转化自然，美妆/服饰/家居优势
domestic.pros_en: High-spending users, natural word-of-mouth conversion, strong in beauty/fashion/home
domestic.cons_zh: 扣点较高，流量规模不如抖快，内容要求高
domestic.cons_en: Higher fees, smaller traffic pool, high content bar

crossborder.entry_zh: 需双币信用卡+营业执照+法人身份证，专业销售计划39.99美元/月
crossborder.entry_en: Dual-currency credit card + business license + legal person ID, $39.99/month Professional plan
crossborder.traffic: 全球最大电商平台，Prime会员体系，FBA物流
crossborder.pros_zh: 客单价高，利润空间大，品牌化机会多
crossborder.pros_en: High AOV, good margins, strong branding opportunities
crossborder.cons_zh: 规则严格，封号风险高，FBA费用不低，需英语能力
crossborder.cons_en: Strict rules, account suspension risk, FBA costs, English required

crossborder.entry_zh: 企业营业执照，免入驻费，前3个月免佣金，之后2%-6%
crossborder.entry_en: Business license, no entry fee, 0% commission first 3 months, then 2%-6%
crossborder.traffic: 东南亚+台湾市场，移动端为主，社交属性强
crossborder.pros_zh: 入驻门槛低，东南亚增长快，适合新手跨境
crossborder.pros_en: Low barrier, fast-growing Southeast Asia, beginner-friendly
crossborder.cons_zh: 客单价低，价格竞争激烈，物流时效要求高
crossborder.cons_en: Low AOV, fierce price competition, fast logistics required

crossborder.entry_zh: 企业营业执照+法人身份证，部分站点需邀请制或本地仓，保证金按站点500-2000美元
crossborder.entry_en: Business license + legal person ID, some sites invite-only, deposit $500-2000 by site
crossborder.traffic: 短视频+直播带货，全球市场（东南亚/英美），算法推荐
crossborder.pros_zh: 流量爆发力极强，内容驱动，新兴市场红利期
crossborder.cons_zh: 政策变动快，达人合作成本高，退货率高
crossborder.cons_en: Fast-changing policies, high creator collaboration costs, high returns

crossborder.entry_zh: 无平台入驻门槛，月费39-399美元，需自行解决流量和支付
crossborder.entry_en: No marketplace approval, $39-399/month subscription, traffic & payments self-managed
crossborder.commission: 无平台佣金，但支付手续费2%（未用Shopify Payments）+ 订阅费
crossborder.commission_en: No marketplace commission, but 2% payment fee + subscription
crossborder.traffic: 独立站模式，需自行引流（Facebook/Google/TikTok广告）
crossborder.pros_zh: 品牌完全自主，无平台规则限制，客户数据自有
crossborder.pros_en: Full brand control, no marketplace rules, owned customer data
crossborder.cons_zh: 需自己搞流量和转化，建站技术要求，前期投入大
crossborder.cons_en: Must drive own traffic, technical setup, high upfront investment

crossborder.entry_zh: 个人信用卡+PayPal账号即可开店，前250条/月免费上架
crossborder.entry_en: Credit card + PayPal account, first 250 listings/month free
crossborder.settlement: 卖家打款到账户后T+21天可用
crossborder.traffic: 欧美成熟市场，拍卖+一口价模式，二手/利基品类优势
crossborder.pros_zh: 入驻最简单，利基产品有优势，欧美用户成熟
crossborder.pros_en: Easiest entry, niche product advantage, mature Western users
crossborder.cons_zh: 流量下滑，手续费高，PayPal风控严格
crossborder.cons_en: Declining traffic, high fees, strict PayPal risk control

crossborder.entry_zh: 企业营业执照，年费1-3万（2023年起取消年费模式改为保证金1万起）
crossborder.entry_en: Business license, deposit from 10k RMB (annual fee model replaced in 2023)
crossborder.traffic: 阿里旗下，俄罗斯/欧洲/拉美市场，全托管模式可选
crossborder.pros_zh: 阿里系流量支持，全托管模式省心，新兴市场增长
crossborder.pros_en: Alibaba ecosystem traffic, fully-managed option, emerging market growth
crossborder.cons_zh: 价格竞争激烈，利润薄，平台规则多变
crossborder.cons_en: Price competition, thin margins, changing platform rules

crossborder.entry_zh: 企业营业执照，保证金3000马币（约5000人民币），东南亚6国市场
crossborder.entry_en: Business license, deposit ~5000 RMB, 6 Southeast Asian markets
crossborder.traffic: 阿里旗下，东南亚市场，品牌化路线
crossborder.pros_zh: 阿里系支持，东南亚中产市场，比Shopee客单价高
crossborder.pros_en: Alibaba support, SEA middle class, higher AOV than Shopee
crossborder.cons_zh: 流量不如Shopee，运营成本高，东南亚语言多样
crossborder.cons_en: Less traffic than Shopee, higher operating costs, diverse languages

fee_calculator.description_zh: 以下费率为各平台公开标准费率，实际以平台最新公告为准
fee_calculator.description_en: Fees below are standard published rates, refer to latest platform announcements

taobao.online_support_zh: 可在千牛卖家中心或商家服务大厅联系在线客服
taobao.online_support_en: Online help is available in the Qianniu seller center

tmall.online_support_zh: 可在天猫商家中心联系在线客服
tmall.online_support_en: Online help is available in the Tmall merchant center

jd.phone_hours_zh: 以商家帮助中心公示为准
jd.online_support_zh: 可在京麦商家后台联系人工客服
jd.online_support_en: Online help is available in the Jingmai seller backend

pdd.online_support_zh: 可在拼多多商家后台联系在线客服
pdd.online_support_en: Online help is available in the Pinduoduo merchant backend

douyin.online_support_zh: 可在抖店后台右下角联系在线客服
douyin.online_support_en: Online help is available at the lower-right of the Doudian backend

kuaishou.online_support_zh: 可在快手电商商家后台联系在线客服
kuaishou.online_support_en: Online help is available in the Kuaishou seller backend

xiaohongshu.online_support_zh: 可在小红书商家管理后台联系在线客服
xiaohongshu.online_support_en: Online help is available in the Xiaohongshu merchant backend

amazon.online_support_zh: 可登录卖家平台，通过“帮助”联系卖家支持；中国卖家可在“全球开店”官网获取招商指引
amazon.online_support_en: Sign in to Seller Central and use Help to contact Seller Support; China-based sellers can find onboarding guidance on the Global Selling site

shopee.online_support_zh: 可在中国卖家中心联系在线客服
shopee.online_support_en: Online help is available in the China Seller Center

tiktokshop.online_support_zh: 可在 TikTok Shop 卖家中心通过“帮助中心”联系客服
tiktokshop.online_support_en: Use the Help Center in the TikTok Shop Seller Center to contact support

shopify.online_support_zh: 可在 Shopify 帮助中心联系在线客服
shopify.online_support_en: Online support is available in the Shopify Help Center

ebay.online_support_zh: 可在 eBay 卖家专区通过“帮助与联系”获取支持
ebay.online_support_en: Use Help & Contact in the eBay seller hub

aliexpress.online_support_zh: 可在速卖通卖家后台联系招商与在线客服
aliexpress.online_support_en: Online help is available in the AliExpress seller backend

lazada.note_zh: Lazada 按国家开设卖家中心，入驻其他站点请选择对应国家的卖家中心
lazada.note_en: Lazada runs a separate seller center per country; choose the seller center of your target country
lazada.online_support_zh: 可在对应国家的卖家中心联系在线客服
lazada.online_support_en: Online help is available in the target country's seller center
